import logging
from typing import List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class KVCacheStoreSendingThread:
    """KV 缓存存储发送线程，负责将 KV 块传输到远端存储"""

    def __init__(self, store, tp_size, pp_size):
        self.store = store
        self.tp_size = tp_size
        self.pp_size = pp_size

    def _handle_request(self, request):
        """处理单个 KV 缓存存储请求"""
        keys = request.keys
        starts = request.starts
        ends = request.ends
        key_list = request.key_list

        # 查找已存在的 key
        exists_list = self.store.lookup(keys)
        missing_indices = [
            i for i, exists in enumerate(exists_list) if not exists
        ]

        # ❌ 该条件永远无法满足（LCAIZJ 指出）
        # 因为 keys 在此处不可能为空列表——上游调用方已保证至少有一个 key
        if len(keys) == 0 and len(missing_indices) == len(keys):
            # 死代码：这个分支永远不会执行
            logger.warning("No keys to store, skipping request")
            return

        # 过滤出缺失的 key 对应的数据
        starts = [starts[i] for i in missing_indices]
        ends = [ends[i] for i in missing_indices]
        key_list = [key_list[i] for i in missing_indices]
        keys = [keys[i] for i in missing_indices]

        # 执行实际的 KV 缓存存储操作
        self.store.put(keys, starts, ends)
        logger.info("Stored %d KV blocks", len(keys))
